protocol.alternative_model_comparison: if fixed local Jacobian matches or outperforms similarity in each axis, generic local recurrent flow is sufficient for the measured geometry; not a distinctive memory mechanism
protocol.basis_fit: rank8 SVD of separately centered A/B training-half clouds only; means and map coefficients use only those32 paired histories
protocol.claim_boundary: label-free finite-window geometry and mechanistic local-linear baseline only; no evidence code, decoder recovery, causal channel, utility, learning or adaptation claim
protocol.corpus: all64 base histories per reliability order; independent balanced targets; B adds two blanks to A; 1024 paired state rows over4 seeds
protocol.coverage_condition: heldout source/target excluded fractions <=0.01 for rank8 geometry conclusions
protocol.descriptive_threshold: full relative residual <=0.1 in every seed/axis for each named map; no automatic hypothesis promotion
protocol.falsifier: large residual rejects the tested common map/local-linear model; inadequate coverage or dominant shared offset prevents a broad deformation claim
protocol.independent_unit: model seed; histories, axes and map comparisons dependent within seed
protocol.jacobian_reference: G(mu_train_A)+DG(mu_train_A)*(zA-mu_train_A), full-state autodiff JVP per evaluation direction; centroid fixed for every evaluation, no relinearization or fitted correction
protocol.metrics: full/centroid/centered residuals and in/out subspace residuals, divided by evaluation A-cloud RMS; source/target excluded fractions; displacement fraction explained
protocol.rank8_jacobian: apply DG to rank8-projected source difference, retain source difference outside basis unchanged; identical fixed training basis to similarity comparison
protocol.sanity: float32 exact G(zA) must equal independently run B for every history; exact rollout is integrity-only, never explanatory prediction; report float64 rollout numerical error
protocol.split: resolve32/32 same-order histories before collection, half each terminal-symbol stratum; exhaustive64 new-order histories evaluation-only
protocol.transition_G: reconstruct identical seed weights; reset runtime step index to38 and clear frozen/trace state inside every closure evaluation; inject encoded blank into fast and step, twice
